questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about hazards ahead. These could be changes in traffic direction, steep hills, or other dangerous situations that need your attention.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Bicycles do not have turn signals. Bicyclists use hand and arm signals instead. When a bicyclist holds their left arm straight out, they are signaling a left turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic going in the same direction will soon combine into one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Check for vehicles only in the direction that you plan on going, then proceed.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must come to a complete stop. Look in all directions for traffic before moving forward.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a reverse curve. The road curves to the right first, then curves to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Proceed at a consistent speed while looking and listening for approaching trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, slow down and look both ways. Listen for trains and be ready to stop if one is coming. Never try to drive faster than an oncoming train.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left then right.
The road ahead curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right then left.
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign with black markings. It tells drivers that the road curves right first, then curves left. Slow down and adjust your speed to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep hill or downgrade ahead. The hill may be long, steep, or have sharp curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May turn left only on a green arrow.
May turn left on a green light when it is safe.
Must wait for the solid green light before you turn left.

questions.correctAnswerText: May turn left on a green light when it is safe.
questions.explanation: "Yield" means you must slow down and be ready to stop. Let any vehicles, bicyclists, or pedestrians pass first. After yielding, you can follow the sign's directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign with black markings. It alerts drivers that bicycles may be crossing the road in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Travel in the direction of the arrow.
Look for a destination sign to follow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Travel in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a lane control sign. It tells you to move in the direction shown by the arrow. In this case, you must move to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles like farm tractors, road maintenance vehicles, and animal-drawn carts display an orange and red triangle on the back.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you that traffic signals are ahead at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted on one-way streets and roadways where you cannot enter. You may see it if you try to enter an expressway ramp in the wrong direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at the marked stop line. If there is no stop line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop before the intersection where you can see oncoming traffic. Only proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drivers must bear either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road splits ahead. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height of a vehicle allowed in this state.
The maximum width of a vehicle allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This is a low clearance warning sign. It shows the distance from the road to the bottom of a bridge or overpass. In this case, the clearance is 12 feet, 6 inches.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop and check for traffic coming from both directions before proceeding.
Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
Maintain a steady speed and check for traffic coming from all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
questions.explanation: A three-sided yield sign means you must slow down and be ready to stop if needed. Let any vehicles, cyclists, or pedestrians pass before you proceed. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve in the road ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You will often see this sign where traffic from the opposite direction is common.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign tells you that a divided highway is starting ahead. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the divided roadway is ending. You are about to enter a highway with traffic going both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Mileage information, such as distances to specific locations.

questions.explanation: Blue signs show where drivers can find services. These include rest areas, food, gas, and hospitals.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell you what traffic laws apply and you must obey them. This sign means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a crossroad is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will curve or become narrower ahead. You may see this sign on sharp curves or at narrow bridges.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings and alert you to hazards ahead. This sign tells you that one lane is closing and you need to move left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead. Always follow the flagger's directions. Flaggers wear orange, yellow, or bright colored clothing. They use paddles and flags to direct traffic safely through work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that wet pavement ahead is slippery and dangerous. Slow down because your car will need more distance to stop on wet roads.
